from accurate import *

def write_component(p,k):
 ledger=ROOT/'main_ledger.json'; state=json.loads(ledger.read_text()) if ledger.exists() else {}
 if str(k) in state:raise RuntimeError('Component already started: '+str(state))
 path=np.load(ROOT/f'component_{k}_path.npy')
 xyz=np.array([p.paper(u,v,dep,False) for u,v,dep in path])
 # Sample z transitions gently; the 0.3 mm travel pressure maintains contact.
 way=[xyz[0]]
 for a,b in zip(xyz[:-1],xyz[1:]):
  N=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:2]-a[:2])/.0075/.05)),int(np.ceil(abs(b[2]-a[2])/.0015/.05)))
  way.extend(np.linspace(a,b,N+1)[1:])
 way=np.r_[way,np.tile(xyz[-1],(10,1))]
 print('MAIN COMPONENT',k,'planned steps',len(way),flush=True)
 p.dip();p.move([xyz[0,0],xyz[0,1],.06],cams=['canvas_cam'])
 state[str(k)]={'status':'started','before':p.r.status(),'path':str(ROOT/f'component_{k}_path.npy')};ledger.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
 p.move(xyz[0],speed=.01,hold=.4,cams=['canvas_cam'],note='main component '+str(k)+' initial contact')
 draw_joint(p,way,'main connected component '+str(k),cams=['canvas_cam'],fps=1)
 p.move([p.pos[0],p.pos[1],.06],speed=.01,cams=['canvas_cam'],note='main component '+str(k)+' lift')
 p.park()
 o=p.r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam']);folder=RUNS/f'main_after_{k}';p.save(o,folder)
 state[str(k)]['status']='completed';state[str(k)]['after']=p.r.status();ledger.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
 print('COMPLETED',k,flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
 p=Painter()
 for k in map(int,sys.argv[1:]):write_component(p,k)
